summary: First Majestic Silver filed a Form 6-K attaching a news release dated November 12, 2026 reporting positive near-surface RC drill results at its Jerritt Canyon gold mine in Nevada and updating restart progress toward a targeted second-half 2027 restart. Highlights include 48.8 m at 4.24 g/t Au and 36.6 m at 5.87 g/t Au at Saval, with 15,983 m completed across 146 holes and assays pending. The filing is a routine operational/exploration update, not a special situation; no transaction, ownership event, or board recommendation is stated. Watch restart timing and resource upgrade potential.
